name: Microwave Mug Dhokla
ingredients: 8 tbsp besan, sifted (4 tbsp per mug)
½ tsp fruit salt (Eno) or ¼ tsp baking soda
Tempering: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp mustard seeds, 4 curry leaves
steps: Whisk the besan, yogurt, water, paste, turmeric and salt in a bowl until smooth. Rest for 5 minutes.
Grease two large mugs. Add half the fruit salt to the batter, mix quickly and divide between the mugs (fill to half).
Microwave each mug on high for 1½–2 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Microwave the oil, mustard seeds and curry leaves in a small bowl for 40 seconds and pour over the dhokla.
note: A quick, single-serving protein snack; do not fill the mugs more than halfway as the batter rises.
